description: DevHub MVP — CV & Portfolio Generator for Developers. GitHub OAuth → AI Content Generation → CV/Portfolio Builder → PDF Export + Public URL

userStories.title: GitHub OAuth Login
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to sign in with my GitHub account so that DevHub can access my GitHub data without me entering it manually.
acceptanceCriteria: Sign in with GitHub button hien thi tren landing page va login page
Click vao button redirect den GitHub OAuth consent page
Sau khi user approve, redirect ve DevHub voi session duoc tao
User profile (avatar, name, email, github_username) duoc luu vao database
GitHub access token duoc luu an toan (encrypted hoac server-side session)
Neu user da co account, login vao account hien co (khong tao duplicate)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Scope: read:user, public_repo. Dung NextAuth.js v5 voi GitHub provider. Backend nhan token tu NextAuth va luu encrypted.

userStories.title: Pull GitHub Data
userStories.description: As a developer, I want DevHub to automatically import my GitHub repositories and stats so that I don't have to enter my project history manually.
acceptanceCriteria: Sau khi login, he thong tu dong goi GitHub API lay: repos (toi da 100 repos moi nhat), languages, stars, bio, avatar URL
Voi moi repo: lay name, description, language, stargazers_count, topics, URL, is_fork, created_at, updated_at
Du lieu duoc luu vao database (bang github_repos va github_profile)
Xu ly GitHub API rate limit gracefully (hien thi error neu bi rate-limited, khong crash)
Toan bo qua trinh xay ra bat dong bo (async job qua BullMQ) — user thay loading state
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Phu thuoc vao US-001. Dung BullMQ + Upstash Redis cho async job. Luu rate limit state vao Redis.

userStories.title: AI Content Generation — Professional Summary
userStories.description: As a developer, I want AI to write a professional summary about me based on my GitHub data so that I don't have to write it myself.
acceptanceCriteria: AI (GPT-4o primary, Gemini fallback) generate doan summary 3-5 cau dua tren: top languages, so repo, so stars, bio GitHub
User co the chon ngon ngu output: Tieng Viet hoac Tieng Anh
Summary duoc luu vao database duoi truong ai_summary tren bang portfolios
User thay summary trong portfolio editor sau khi generation xong
Neu AI call that bai, hien thi error message ro rang va cho phep retry
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Phu thuoc vao US-002. Dung LangChain.js. Cache ket qua AI vao DB, khong regenerate neu GitHub data khong doi. Cost ~$0.005-0.015 per call.

userStories.title: AI Content Generation — Project Descriptions
userStories.description: As a developer, I want AI to write professional descriptions for my top projects so that each project sounds impressive and clear.
acceptanceCriteria: AI generate description (2-4 cau) cho top 6 repos (sort by stars, loai is_fork=true)
Description dua tren: repo name, description goc, language, topics, README (neu co, toi da 500 chars dau)
User co the chon ngon ngu output: Tieng Viet hoac Tieng Anh (dong bo voi setting AI summary)
Descriptions luu vao database tren bang portfolio_projects
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Phu thuoc vao US-002. Goi GitHub API lay README.md cho moi repo (GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/readme).

userStories.title: AI Content Generation — Skills List
userStories.description: As a developer, I want AI to extract and rank my technical skills from my GitHub data so that my skill section is accurate and relevant.
acceptanceCriteria: AI phan tich toan bo languages tu tat ca repos va tao danh sach skills co thu tu uu tien
Ket qua la mang string, vi du: [TypeScript, React, Node.js, PostgreSQL, ...]
Toi da 15 skills
Skills luu vao database duoi truong ai_skills (JSON array) tren bang portfolios
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Phu thuoc vao US-002. Co the combine voi US-003 trong cung mot AI call de tiet kiem cost.

userStories.title: Landing Page
userStories.description: As a potential user, I want to see a professional landing page so that I understand what DevHub offers before signing up.
acceptanceCriteria: Landing page co: headline ro rang, sub-headline, CTA Get Started with GitHub, section how it works (3 buoc), section benefits, footer
Page load < 2 giay (LCP)
Responsive tren mobile (375px) va desktop (1280px)
CTA button link den GitHub OAuth flow
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Co the lam song song voi US-001 den US-005. Next.js static page (khong can auth). Design: Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui.

userStories.title: Template Selection
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to choose from multiple CV/portfolio templates so that my portfolio matches my personal style.
acceptanceCriteria: Hien thi toi thieu 2 templates: Light (nen trang) va Dark (nen toi)
User nhin thay thumbnail preview cua moi template truoc khi chon
Click vao template → portfolio editor load voi template do
Lua chon template duoc luu vao database (field template_id tren bang portfolios)
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Phu thuoc vao US-003, US-004, US-005. Template la React components rieng biet. template_id la enum: light | dark.

userStories.title: User Dashboard
userStories.description: As a logged-in developer, I want a dashboard where I can see and manage my portfolio so that I have a central hub for all DevHub actions.
acceptanceCriteria: Sau khi login, redirect den dashboard
Dashboard hien thi: avatar, ten, portfolio URL, trang thai privacy, nut Edit Portfolio, nut View Public Portfolio, nut Export PDF, nut Re-sync GitHub
Neu portfolio chua duoc generate lan dau: hien thi onboarding flow bat dau generate
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Phu thuoc vao US-001. Onboarding flow: Login → trigger US-002 → trigger US-003/004/005 → redirect editor.

userStories.title: Portfolio Editor — WYSIWYG Editing
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to edit my AI-generated content directly in the portfolio editor so that I can fix mistakes or add personal touches.
acceptanceCriteria: Moi text field trong portfolio (summary, project descriptions, skills, ten, title) deu co the click de edit inline
Thay doi duoc auto-save (debounce 1s) hoac co nut Save ro rang
User co the revert ve AI-generated content goc cho tung field
Editing khong lam mat layout/formatting cua template
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Phu thuoc vao US-006. Luu ca ai_content (goc) va user_content (da chinh sua) rieng biet trong DB de ho tro revert.

userStories.title: Toggle Projects On/Off
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to hide specific repositories from my portfolio so that I can choose which projects to showcase.
acceptanceCriteria: Trong portfolio editor, moi project card co toggle switch Show / Hide
Hidden projects khong hien thi tren public portfolio
Preferences duoc luu vao database (field is_visible tren bang portfolio_projects)
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Phu thuoc vao US-007. is_visible default = true.

userStories.title: Portfolio Privacy Controls
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to control who can see my portfolio so that I can keep it private while I'm still editing.
acceptanceCriteria: Trong settings, user co the chon 1 trong 3 muc privacy: public / unlisted / private
Public: ai cung xem duoc, search engine index duoc (<meta name=robots content=index,follow>)
Unlisted: chi nguoi co link moi xem duoc, khong index (<meta name=robots content=noindex>)
Private: chi owner xem duoc, return HTTP 401 cho unauthenticated request
Mac dinh khi tao moi: private
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Phu thuoc vao US-001. privacy la enum: public | unlisted | private tren bang portfolios. Middleware kiem tra auth cho private.

userStories.title: Custom URL Slug
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to choose my own portfolio URL slug so that my link is personal and memorable.
acceptanceCriteria: Trong settings, user co the nhap custom slug (chi chap nhan: a-z, 0-9, dau gach ngang)
He thong kiem tra slug co unique khong — neu da ton tai hien thi loi ro rang
Slug mac dinh = GitHub username cua user
Sau khi doi slug, old URL tra ve 404
Slug toi thieu 3 ky tu, toi da 30 ky tu
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Phu thuoc vao US-001. slug la unique index tren bang portfolios. Validate regex: ^[a-z0-9-]{3,30}$. Reserved slugs: api, admin, login, logout, dashboard, settings.

userStories.title: Public Portfolio URL
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a shareable public portfolio link so that I can send it to recruiters or clients.
acceptanceCriteria: Moi user co portfolio URL dang: devhub.io/[slug]
Portfolio page public accessible, khong can login de xem (neu privacy = public hoac unlisted)
Portfolio page render dung tren server (SSR) de SEO indexable
<title> tag = [Ten User] — Developer Portfolio | DevHub
<meta description> duoc generate tu AI summary
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Phu thuoc vao US-010, US-011, US-012. Next.js route: app/[slug]/page.tsx. Dung generateMetadata() cho SEO.

userStories.title: Re-sync GitHub Data
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to refresh my GitHub data so that my portfolio reflects my latest projects and contributions.
acceptanceCriteria: Nut Re-sync GitHub trong portfolio editor hoac settings
Click button → trigger async BullMQ job pull lai toan bo GitHub data
Sau khi sync xong, portfolio editor tu refresh voi data moi
Hien thi timestamp Last synced: X minutes ago
Rate limit: user chi co the re-sync toi da 1 lan / 10 phut (hien thi countdown neu bi limit)
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Phu thuoc vao US-002. Luu last_synced_at vao bang github_profile. Kiem tra rate limit trong Redis (key: resync:{userId}, TTL: 600s).

userStories.title: Export PDF
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to export my CV as a PDF so that I can attach it to job applications.
acceptanceCriteria: Nut Export PDF ro rang trong portfolio editor
PDF duoc generate server-side bang Puppeteer (headless Chrome)
PDF trong giong het portfolio preview tren browser (WYSIWYG)
PDF download ve may user voi filename devhub-cv-[username].pdf
File size PDF < 5MB
Generate time < 15 giay (hien thi loading spinner trong luc cho)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Phu thuoc vao US-007. Puppeteer can --no-sandbox flag tren Railway. PDF duoc luu tam tren Cloudflare R2 roi stream ve client. Can config Railway service co >= 512MB RAM.
